{{Quote|I had a nephew who was a deck monkey on the ''Battle Lance''.''"<br />"''Yeah. I knew a couple of guys shipped on her. It was a freak accident.|Tenn Graneet and Mekkar Doan|<ref name="DS" />}}
The '''''Battle Lance''''' was a<ref name="DS" /> 1,600 [[Meter/Legends|meter]]&ndash;long<ref name="DB" /> [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="DS" /> manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]<ref name="EGTW" /> that served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. Sometime before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="DS" /> the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] was selected to test an improved prototype [[Hypermatter reactor/Legends|hypermatter reactor]]. Due to a malfunction, the [[Zero-point energy|null-point energy]] produced by the drive became unstable and vaporized the ''Battle Lance'' in a [[Microsecond/Legends|microsecond]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] entire crew of 37,000. [[Hora Graneet]], the nephew of [[Imperial gunner/Legends|Imperial gunner]] [[Tenn Graneet]], served on the ship and died during the accident.<ref name="DS" />

Sometime between [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Destruction Date" /> Graneet mentioned the ''Battle Lance''{{'s}} destruction to explain to [[Chief Petty Officer/Legends|Chief Petty Officer]] [[Mekkar Doan]] why he had doubts about the functionality of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. Doan, who had been smiling, grew somber and stated that he had known multiple personnel aboard the ''Battle Lance''. After the conversation, Graneet felt unsettled as he compared the power of that [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]] with the power of the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star's]] [[Concave Dish Composite Beam Superlaser|superlaser]].<ref name="DS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Battle Lance'' was mentioned in the [[2007]] novel [[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']], written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]].<ref name="DS" />
